t: Forge Steel 1000mm stainless steel ruler provides precise and reliable measurements for a multitude of trade applications. The robust measuring tool is an essential asset for joiners, builders, and fabricators who require accurate marking out and cutting guides in workshops or on site. Constructed from durable stainless steel, it resists corrosion and mechanical damage, ensuring longevity and consistent performance. Etched with both metric and imperial scales for convenient and error-free readings across diverse project specifications.
